problem: The cubic polynomial $P(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=-5,$ ${x}_{2}=0,$ and ${x}_{3}=1,$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $-2.$ Find $P(x).$

feedback.problem: The cubic polynomial $P(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}={x}_{2}=-1,{x}_{3}=3,$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $2.$ Find $P(x).$
feedback.worked_solution:
Since our cubic polynomial has roots ${x}_{1}={x}_{2}=-1$ and ${x}_{3}=3,$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $a=2,$ we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3}) & =2(x-(-1))(x-(-1))(x-3) \\  & =2(x+1)(x+1)(x-3)\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}2(x+1)(x+1)(x-3) & =2({x}^{2}+2x+1)(x-3) \\  & =2({x}^{3}-3{x}^{2}+2{x}^{2}-6x+x-3) \\  & =2({x}^{3}-{x}^{2}-5x-3) \\  & =2{x}^{3}-2{x}^{2}-10x-6.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $P(x)=2{x}^{3}-2{x}^{2}-10x-6.$
